_doc: Classification of every action the LIVE engine emits, by whether the BACKTEST can reproduce it. Consumed by setup/scripts/parity_check.py. An action the live engine emits that is absent here is UNCLASSIFIED and turns the check RED -- that is the alarm, and it is the exact state VETOED_BY_MODELS sat in unnoticed for 38 days while every backtest silently overstated trade count.

_status_vocabulary.MODELED: The backtest reproduces this refusal. Cite the backtest-side file:line.
_status_vocabulary.LIVE_ONLY_INTENTIONAL: Live-only BY DESIGN with no meaningful backtest equivalent (e.g. broker-race guards). Must carry a reason.
_status_vocabulary.LIVE_ONLY_DIVERGENCE: Live refuses, the backtest CANNOT. Backtest is optimistic by this action's share of actionable ticks.

_rule: Only classify what you have independently verified with file:line on BOTH sides. Leaving something UNCLASSIFIED is honest; guessing MODELED to get a green light is the failure this file exists to prevent.
_seeded: 2026-08-12 -- seeded with the 5 actions verified by adversarial audit this session (workflow wf_66f0df68-a26, parity lane: 5 claims upheld, 0 refuted). Everything else is deliberately left UNCLASSIFIED rather than assumed.

VETOED_BY_MODELS.reason: The free-model veto ran ONLY in heartbeat_core.run_account's live tick wrapper (heartbeat_core.py:1581-1583), after the shared engine_cli verdict. Verified absent from engine_cli.py, gates.py, score.py, orchestrator.py, simulator_real.py, simulator_real_trailing.py, engine_fullhist_replay.py, replay_heartbeat_core.py and dojo/engine_step.py. It killed 132 of 656 live ENTER verdicts (20.1%) across 38 days while every backtest assumed those trades were taken. DISABLED on the money path 2026-08-12 (commit 073469a9, GAMMA_FREE_MODEL_VETO defaults off), which finally aligns live with what backtests always represented -- but every pre-2026-08-12 backtest verdict still carries this bias.
VETOED_BY_MODELS.verified: 2026-08-12, 12 claims upheld / 0 refuted, ledger counts recomputed from raw JSONL by an independent verifier

SKIP_STRUCTURE_VETO.reason: structure_veto_enabled is true in Safe's params.json and enforced every live tick inside engine_cli.decide_payload -- but the veto lives in engine_cli.py, not gates.py, and orchestrator.run_backtest calls score_bar/evaluate_gates DIRECTLY, never decide_payload. So no backtest kwarg can switch it on: it is architecturally invisible to every orchestrator-based tool.

RISK_DENY_PDT.reason: orchestrator.py's risk_gate assert-agree call explicitly neutralises PDT limits, so the backtest takes day-trades the live PDT counter refuses. Rule 7 is a hard live constraint with no backtest counterpart.

RISK_DENY_SETTLEMENT.reason: Same orchestrator neutralisation. The cash-settlement branch is doubly unreachable in backtest: settled_cash_available/same_day_entries_used are never supplied, AND orchestrator never sets pdt_gate_mode at all (zero occurrences), so it always defaults to margin_pdt and the branch is gated off before the None-check is reached.
RISK_DENY_SETTLEMENT.verified: 2026-08-12 adversarial verify, upheld (verifier added the second, more fundamental mechanism)

RISK_DENY_RISK_CAP.reason: Same orchestrator risk_gate neutralisation -- kill-switch and prior-stop state are not threaded into the backtest, so per-trade risk-cap refusals never fire there.

SKIP_QUALITY_LOCK.reason: THE engine_cli BLIND SPOT. Enforced inside backtest/lib/engine/engine_cli.py, which is shared code by location but NOT by call path: orchestrator.run_backtest imports only score_bar and evaluate_gates (orchestrator.py:40-43) and never calls decide_payload -- the single mention of engine_cli in orchestrator.py is a comment at :1301. So every orchestrator-based backtest tool is architecturally incapable of reproducing this refusal, exactly like SKIP_STRUCTURE_VETO. Being in a 'shared' file is not the same as being on the shared call path, and that distinction is what hid this.

_engine_cli_blind_spot: SKIP_STRUCTURE_VETO, SKIP_QUALITY_LOCK and SKIP_BAD_INPUT share one root cause: they are enforced in engine_cli.decide_payload, which no orchestrator-based backtest calls. 152 live refusals (6.9% of actionable) that no backtest can reproduce. Fixing the class -- routing backtests through decide_payload, or lifting these into gates.py -- closes all three at once and prevents the next one.
